name: LAMF Memory
description: LAMF (Local Agent Memory Fabric) native memory capability for OpenClaw: governed, event-sourced, local-first agent memory with taint-badged context injection.

lamfUrl.description: Base URL of the local LAMF server (loopback).

tokenFile.description: Path to the LAMF bearer token file written by the installer (`lamf init`).

captureEnabled.description: Capture final-turn messages into LAMF on agent_end.

injectContext.description: Inject the LAMF orientation capsule before prompt assembly.

maxContextTokens.description: Token budget requested for injected context; hard-clamped server-side to the active policy's context.capsule_max_tokens.
